prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Bruno, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Bruno trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ve heard from a very reliable source that the pool is definitely closing for good this week. We should all prepare for the worst since this seems to be happening immediately."
text: The pool staff just confirmed it's shutting down permanently effective immediately, so our local facility is officially gone for good starting this week. We are losing everything, so everyone needs to brace for this total disaster right now.
